name: La Belle Lucie
description: La Belle Lucie (also known as Lovely Lucy or Three Shuffles and a Draw) is a classic 'Fan' type solitaire game. It is known for its high difficulty and the requirement for careful planning. Unlike Klondike, all cards are dealt face-up into 17 three-card fans, allowing the player to see the entire deck from the start. However, only the top card of each fan is playable, making card blocking a constant challenge.

content.text: La Belle Lucie (also known as Lovely Lucy or Three Shuffles and a Draw) is a classic 'Fan' type solitaire game. It is known for its high difficulty and the requirement for careful planning. Unlike Klondike, all cards are dealt face-up into 17 three-card fans, allowing the player to see the entire deck from the start. However, only the top card of each fan is playable, making card blocking a constant challenge.
Dates to the 19th-century French card salons. It is one of the earliest 'Perfect Information' solitaires, where no cards are hidden.
One player only. La Belle Lucie is a patience (solitaire) game played by a single player, who moves cards from the tableau fans to the four foundations. There are no partners or opponents.
Table space for 18 fan piles and four foundation piles.
Deal all 52 cards face-up into 17 fans of three cards each and one single card as the 18th fan. When redealing, reshuffle and redeal in the same pattern (fans of three with remainder as last fan).

items.text: Trefoil: Aces are moved to foundations first; remaining 48 cards are dealt in 16 fans of three.
The Fan: Empty fan may be filled with a King. No redeals allowed.
Three Shuffles and a Draw: After two reshuffles, one mercy draw: player may pick one buried card (not a top card) to continue the game.
